title: Event UI
description: Custom quest & UI system for servers rendered client-side via Fabric.
body:
## EventUI

Lets you create missions with a customizable UI, real-time progress tracking, and a client mod + server plugin.

###  Key Features
**100% Customizable UI**

- Define your screens using simple YAML files

- Upload custom textures for buttons, backgrounds, and icons

- Multi-screen navigation system with submenus

- Tooltips with items and text 

- Hover effects

### **⚙️ Dual UI System**

  Default mode: Predefined UI with EventUI featuring scrolling, mini-navs, categories, and filters

  Custom mode: Design your own screens using YAML 

  Switch between modes—you can decide what to display via a “config.yml” configuration file with EventUI Plugin.

### **📊 Real-Time Progress**

  Progress bars update instantly from the server

  Quest tracker HUD showing your active quests

  Notifications for completed quests and unlocked events

### **🎮 20+ Types of Goals**

  Mine blocks, kill mobs, craft items

  Explore biomes, visit dimensions

  Reach XP levels, use enchantments

  Complete achievements, custom goals, and many more.

### **🔗 Dependency System**

  Events that unlock upon completing others

  Clear display of locked events

  Automatic validation of prerequisites

### **⚠️ Planned Features**

*- Support for sequential, parallel, or weighted objectives*
*- Many more types of objectives*


### Environments
Client-side mod

**On servers without the plugin, the mod does nothing.**

### Tool
[YAML Builder for EventUI (Spanish only)](https://event-ui-forge.lovable.app/)

### Wiki
[Link (Spanish only)](https://eventuiwiki.netlify.app)

### Support & suggestions Discord
[Discord (Spanish only)](https://discord.gg/PRU3yMN3Z8)

### Important
This mod does nothing on its own. You need to connect to a server running the EventUI Plugin to receive UI configurations and event data.
